paragraphs.text: Umori , the Collector is a legendary ooze from the plane of Ikoria .

According to Vivien Reid 's studies, Umori harvests the crystals that dot Ikoria and sticks them into its body as a form of decoration. While the crystals stop glowing when picked, Umori can make them glow in batches on command, creating a natural light show.
Umori fought in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
